# Citable facts

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_facts_doc.py from the domain modules; do not edit by hand. -->

Every fact a written proof can cite, by domain. A step cites a fact by its name, with the
hypotheses or earlier steps it uses:

```py
pl.claim(geo.similar((B, A, C), (C, A, D)), because=[geo.similar_AA, "hABC", "hA"])
pl.conclude(because=[geo.cpctc, "hcong"])     # a family: Lean uses the part that fits
```

The **Label** is how the printed proof states the fact. To find a fact by what it says,
search the labels and names: `pl.search_facts("similar triangles")` from Python, or
`pyleanx facts similar triangles` from the shell.

**Source** says where the proof of the fact lives: *Mathlib* (a Mathlib theorem, used as
is) or *PyLeanX* (stated and proved in PyLeanX; its Lean proof is included in every file
that cites it and re-checked by Lean each time).

390 facts in 8 domains: [Plane geometry](#plane-geometry) (77), [Real-variable methods](#real-variable-methods) (157), [Real analysis](#real-analysis) (64), [Algebra](#algebra) (29), [Number theory](#number-theory) (17), [Complex analysis](#complex-analysis) (7), [Harmonic analysis](#harmonic-analysis) (19), [The Hilbert transform](#the-hilbert-transform) (20).
